retrieval_ablation.relevance_rule: a retrieved chunk is relevant iff its (doc_id, page) is a gold (doc_id, page) pair

metric_definitions.recall_at_5: share of gold (doc, page) pairs covered by the top-5 chunks
metric_definitions.precision_at_5: share of the top-5 chunks that lie on a gold (doc, page)
metric_definitions.mrr_at_5: mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant chunk within the top 5 (0 if none)

gate1_abstention.note: Gate 1 only (CRAG rerank threshold, before any LLM call). Cases that pass Gate 1 can still be refused at Gates 2-4; see --full.

metrics.faithfulness_basis: 28/28 shown answer sentences backed by a verified source quote (pipeline-reported, pooled)
metrics.hallucination_leakage_basis: 1/28 shown claims failed the independent audit (uncited, quote absent from the PDF page, number not in quote, forbidden value, or shown where the right answer is a refusal)
metrics.citation_exact_match_basis: 30/30 citations whose quote re-appears verbatim on the cited PDF page (re-read with PyMuPDF)

contradiction.definition: case-level; TP needs a reported conflict whose >=2 docs are all gold evidence docs

metrics.superseded_fp_basis: 0/7 negative-control cases (amendment-explained differences) that were wrongly raised as a conflict
metrics.amendment_resolution_basis: 12/12 cases: chain active doc == gold and the answer cites it
